title: Do Not Hide Your Face from Me

questions.question: Hear my prayer, O Lord; let my cry come to whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 102:1 (ESV): "Hear my prayer, O Lord; let my cry come to you!"

questions.question: Do not hide your face from me in the day of my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 102:2 (ESV): "Do not hide your face from me in the day of my distress!"

questions.question: Incline your ear to me; answer me speedily in the day when I do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 102:2 (ESV): "...answer me speedily in the day when I call!"

questions.question: For my days pass away like what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 102:3 (ESV): "For my days pass away like smoke,"

questions.question: My heart is struck down like grass and has what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 102:4 (ESV): "My heart is struck down like grass and has withered;"

questions.question: Because of my loud groaning my bones cling to my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 102:5 (ESV): "Because of my loud groaning my bones cling to my flesh."

questions.question: I am like a desert owl of the wilderness, like an owl of the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 102:6 (ESV): "...like an owl of the waste places;"

questions.question: I lie awake; I am like a lonely sparrow on the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 102:7 (ESV): "...I am like a lonely sparrow on the housetop."

questions.question: For I eat ashes like bread and mingle my tears with my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 102:9 (ESV): "...and mingle my tears with my drink,"

questions.question: But you, O Lord, are enthroned when?
questions.explanation: Psalm 102:12 (ESV): "But you, O Lord, are enthroned forever;"

questions.question: You will arise and have pity on Zion; it is the time to favor her; the appointed time has what?
He regards the prayer of the destitute and does not despise their what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 102:17 (ESV): "...and does not despise their prayer."

questions.question: Let this be recorded for a generation to come, so that a people yet to be created may praise the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 102:18 (ESV): "...so that a people yet to be created may praise the Lord:"

questions.question: Of old you laid the foundation of the earth, and the heavens are the work of your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 102:25 (ESV): "...and the heavens are the work of your hands."

questions.question: They will perish, but you will remain; they will all wear out like a what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 102:26 (ESV): "...they will all wear out like a garment." (Quoted in Hebrews 1)

key_verse_text: Of old you laid the foundation of the earth, and the heavens are the work of your hands. They will perish, but you will remain; they will all wear out like a garment. You will change them like a robe, and they will pass away, but you are the same, and your years have no end.
